{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.64

|arg= local

|gr1= Pilot Camera

|descr= Returns model space vector of the object airplane or helicopter [[A3_Targeting_config_reference#class_pilotCamera|pilotCamera]] .

|s1= [[getPilotCameraDirection]] object

|r1= [[Vector3D]] - relative to the model centre (In a similar fashion to [[Position#PositionRelative|PositionRelative]]). Returns [0,0,0] if object has no [[A3_Targeting_config_reference#class_pilotCamera|pilotCamera]].
